outcome: accepted within bounded logical runtime editing and composition-state scope
source_checks: Committed selection creation/replacement preserves extended-grapheme boundaries; forward/backward deletion and directional selection operate in explicitly logical order.

UTF-8 scalar-only IME cursor ranges are checked before slicing; all private replacement ranges derive from accepted committed selections, and bounded length arithmetic cannot overflow supported usize sizes.

Repeated preedit replaces the same unchanged committed selection; cancel/empty preedit preserves it, commit replaces it once, and programmatic selection/text or focus loss explicitly cancels composition.
Byte-length and cursor admission precede candidate allocation/publication. Invalid selections, oversized commit/preedit/text and IME-owned ordinary-key refusals preserve all prior observable fields.
No implicit normalization, clipping, project mutation, authoring dependencies, system-font discovery or OS calls are introduced.
The real packaged-font shaping regression exercises CJK substitution/cluster offsets, retained identical preedit storage and shaped-cache identity across commit.
Compared all958 Cargo lock records against frozen base; resolutions/sources/checksums are identical. Only incant_text adds the already-pinned unicode-segmentation1.13.3 edge.
limitations: No platform IME event delivery, input-generation/focus routing, clipboard, widget ownership, visual bidi cursor movement, hit testing or complete Game UI acceptance. Platform adapters still own stale-event routing across focus sessions.

16KiB bounds apply separately to committed and composed strings. Candidate replacement can coexist with both, up to three bounded logical string payloads, excluding allocator/shaping/font storage; this is not a whole-process heap claim.
Review inspected source and parsed supplied completed logs; no independent build, test execution, graphics, screenshot or device run was performed.
